notes: Extraction fidelity only. No retrieval, no answer quality, no medical correctness.
Every fixture is synthetic and generated by the script above; expectations are exact.
Counts are baselined on the environment recorded in baseline_environment. The layout
model's classification of borderline regions (headers/footers, captions, formulas, list
grouping) can differ on another CPU or torch build, so this dataset is re-baselined per
environment rather than relaxed. Cell contents, grid geometry, page counts and reading
order were stable across the environments measured; semantic labels were not.
A change here is a signal to review, never to silently widen the expectation.

cases.name: basic-text
cases.description: Title, section heading and body paragraphs on a single page.
required_text: This paragraph exists to verify that plain body text is extracted intact.

cases.name: multi-page
cases.description: Three pages with repeated running head and foot, chapter and section headings.

cases.name: table
cases.description: One 4x4 table with a header row and an explicit caption beneath it.

cases.name: continued-table
cases.description: A table split across two pages; the continuation must stay a separate table.

cases.name: figure
cases.description: A raster diagram with an explicit caption and surrounding body text.
required_text: Figure 1. Synthetic diagram caption for parser testing.

cases.name: formula
cases.description: One displayed equation set as a fraction with an equation number.

cases.name: two-column
cases.description: Two columns separated by a gutter; reading order must be column-wise.

cases.name: question-bank
cases.description: Assessment layout: numbered stem, A-D options, Answer and Explanation cues.

cases.name: scanned-like
cases.description: A rasterized page with no text layer; content must come from OCR.

baseline_environment.note: Layout classification is not bit-identical across CPU/BLAS environments.
